items.text: Cardinals trade WR Marvin Harrison Jr. (+2027 7th) to Texans for 2027 2nd + 6th; MHJ inactive for ARI today, bio updated.
items.why: Blockbuster deal completed; was already inactive pending.
items.implication: HOU adds elite WR opposite Nico; ARI WRs (Wilson etc) see immediate role bump ROS.
items.opportunity: Michael Wilson and ARI pass-catchers upgraded; HOU depth chart shift.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery downgraded to out with groin injury (was Q).
items.implication: HOU backfield shifts; monitor other RBs for expanded role.

items.text: FINAL UPDATE: Ashton Jeanty will play.
items.why: Pregame workout cleared; plantar/ankle flare monitored but go.
items.implication: Starts but workload may be limited; monitor snaps.
items.opportunity: Primary RB role if full; handcuff upside if limited.

items.text: FINAL UPDATE: Terry McLaurin will play.
items.why: Cleared after hamstring; may be limited in return.
items.implication: Active with Diggs out and Daniels back; volume opportunity but risk.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins will play (updated from questionable). Projections updated on site.
items.why: Weekend reports and final updates confirm both play vs Dolphins.
items.implication: Full CIN WR duo available; no major downgrade.

items.text: Justin Jefferson expected to play / active; Jordan Addison not expected to play / inactive.
items.why: Jefferson eager for home-state game; Addison sits.
items.implication: Jefferson returns (possibly managed snaps); Addison absence boosts Jefferson target share.
items.opportunity: Higher routes/targets for Jefferson without Addison.

items.text: 49ers WR Deebo Samuel Sr. out for remainder of game due to hamstring.
items.implication: SF WR/TE targets redistribute rest of game and potentially beyond.
items.opportunity: Boost to other SF pass-catchers (e.g. Kittle already active).

items.why: Foot issue cleared for SNF vs ATL (Huntley starting).

items.text: Coaching staffs refuse workhorse on Jaylen Warren despite advanced stats/eye test; was splitting with Rico Dowdle pre-injury. Insane; Austin Ekeler-esque.
items.why: Passes every test; Dowdle out opens full role.
items.implication: Warren locked as workhorse RB2+ with Dowdle sidelined.

items.text: George Kittle officially active (illness but expected to play).
items.why: Illness but cleared; Deebo later out boosts him.
items.opportunity: High target share especially post-Deebo exit.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey active but not expected to play meaningful snaps.
items.why: Listed active yet minimal expected usage.
items.implication: Avoid in lineups; other LAC WRs absorb routes/targets.
items.opportunity: Role expansion for Quentin Johnston or others.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams officially inactive but has chance to play next week.
items.implication: Bears backup QB starts; pass game efficiency drop possible.
items.opportunity: Check CHI WR/RB usage under backup.

items.text: Holy hell what a TD catch by Trey McBride.
items.why: Highlight-reel TD reinforces elite TE usage.
items.implication: Continues as TE1 staple; strong weekly floor/ceiling.

items.text: Marshawn Lloyd killing it on waiver wires everywhere.
items.implication: Hot waiver add for GB RB depth/handcuff or flex.
